title: Scarborough Fair
source: Traditional English ballad (Child 2, "The Elfin Knight"). Words and air from Frank Kidson, Traditional Tunes (Oxford: Chas. Taphouse & Son, 1891), pp. 42-44, "Scarborough Fair", as sung by a ballad singer in Whitby streets (Kidson d. 1926): the first four stanzas. Not the Dorian tune collected from Mark Anderson in 1947 (printed in the 1950s) and not the 1960s arrangements. Harmony and tab are original.
